summary: Strong B2.4 modelling capstone: BUILD-DRAW-WRITE pipeline is explicit; expanded_walkthrough names a real G1 trap (correct equation but tape diagram drawn as only the answer) and recovery branches by diagnostic with a sentence frame and counter fallback. Materials are everyday; Plus and Minnie anchor minds_on/consolidation. Worksheet covers three problem types plus a child-generated transfer prompt. Consistency is achieving (3) not exceeding: Box B Part 1 (18+12=30) and Box B Part 3 (11+17=28) push past the lesson's modelled range without the variance being justified as a transfer step.
